377:t_3:8.en:
$$桂$$
「I see. So that's why they treated $$鉄人$$, which uses solar energy, as an enemy.」

377:t_3:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「In the $$時獄戦役$$, $$鉄人$$'s solar power let us defeat the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ once, after all.」

377:t_3:13.en:
$$ティティ$$
「I'm sorry, $$正太郎$$. Because of me, $$鉄人$$'s controller got stolen...」

377:t_3:14.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's my fault too for not explaining things properly. Please don't worry about it.」

377:t_3:16.en:
$$勝平$$
「Is that really okay with you!? We and $$鉄人$$ could've been blown to bits, you know!」

377:t_3:17.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Everyone makes mistakes and fails sometimes.」

377:t_3:18.en:
$$正太郎$$
「What matters is learning something from them. Like $$グーラ$$ over there.」

377:t_3:19.en:
$$ティティ$$
「That kid... is he a friend of yours, $$正太郎$$?」

377:t_3:20.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Yes. We were born on different planets, but he's a precious friend to me.」

377:t_3:21.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「$$正太郎$$'s smile... That may be the sun that came down to earth.」

377:t_3:23.en:
$$ケンジ$$
「$$ズール$$ is alive, and yet you look cheerful.」

377:t_3:24.en:
$$タケル$$
「If he's come back to life, I'll just defeat him again.」

377:t_3:25.en:
$$タケル$$
「It's not a pointless fight. I believe that's my mission.」

377:t_3:26.en:
$$タケル$$
(But there's something that bothers me...)

377:t_3:27.en:
$$タケル$$
(That word $$ゲシュタルト$$ used, 'true war'... I've heard it before, back in the $$時獄戦役$$ too...)

377:t_3:28.en:
$$タケル$$
(Hearing that word fills me with a strange sense of foreboding. What in the world is it...)

377:t_3:29.en:
$$タケル$$
(Could that be the true nature of the unease I've been feeling...)

377:t_3:34.en:
$$ギルター$$
「That man $$ゲシュタルト$$ or whatever his name is! He talks big and in the end he failed, didn't he!」

377:t_3:35.en:
$$ギルター$$
「...Well, no matter. His failure doesn't make it my mistake. All that's left is to strike those worn-out enemies...」

377:t_3:36.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...You've done something rather unfortunate, $$ギルター$$.」

377:t_3:37.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$サルディアス$$! I-I haven't done anything yet!」

377:t_3:38.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「But you did let an outsider into $$ターミナル・ベース$$, didn't you?」

377:t_3:40.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Regarding that matter, our boss seems to be quite, quite furious, you see.」

377:t_3:41.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Apparently that outsider... hacked into the network and pulled out $$サイデリアル$$'s classified information.」

377:t_3:43.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「By the way, $$ギルター$$... do you know who that outsider is?」

377:t_3:44.en:
$$ギルター$$
「H-he had the traits of someone from the $$ギシン星$$ system, but...」

377:t_3:45.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sigh... If you're going to bill yourself as a strategist, I'd like you to know a little more.」

377:t_3:47.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「...No, there's no point in you knowing.」

377:t_3:48.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Still, to the boss, helping that man is absolutely unforgivable... a breach of trust, so to speak.」

377:t_3:49.en:
$$ギルター$$
「W-what should I do!? Tell me, $$サルディアス$$...!」

377:t_3:50.en:
$$ギルター$$
「No! Please tell me, $$サルディアス$$!」

377:t_3:51.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Hmm... With your failures so far too, however I look at it, it adds up to a full-point loss, and I don't think there's room for a comeback...」

377:t_3:52.en:
$$ギルター$$
「P-please, somehow...! I don't want to fall to $$アンタレス$$!」

377:t_3:55.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「If you're that determined, I'll lend you something special. Depending on how it's used, it should display tremendous power.」

377:t_3:56.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Use this to bury $c, and the boss might forgive you.」

377:t_3:57.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Thank you! Thank you so much, $$サルディアス$$!」

377:t_3:58.en:
$$サルディアス$$
(Now then, $$ギルター$$... I wonder if you can handle it?)

377:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, Mr. $$正太郎$$. Thank you for showing me something wonderful. I, $$ＡＧ$$, am overcome with gratitude.」

377:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your friendship with Prince $$グーラ$$. When the two of you defeated the enemy in tandem, I myself ended up producing a $$Ｚチップ$$.」

377:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The amount comes to 50 Z... I'll add it to the unit's stock.」

377:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm surprised at myself too. It must be because I've been watching Mr. $$正太郎$$ and Prince $$グーラ$$ ever since the $$時獄戦役$$.」

377:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That being the case, I will keep cheering on you both from now on.」

377:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That pure heart... It is what will become the power to defeat the darkness.)

377:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If the power of darkness gathers, the power of light gathers too... The paths to $$シンカ$$ that split in two can only cross in the form of battle, I suppose...)

377:t_10:19.en:
$$宗介$$
「You fought well on your own until $$正太郎$$ got back. You're a full-fledged warrior now.」

377:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$オックス$$ is overjoyed. Being recognized by all of you must be such a joy.」

377:t_10:24.en:
$$シモン$$
「What's $$オックス$$ saying this time?」

377:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$オックス$$ says that someday, like $$チェインバー#pilot$$, $$オックス$$ wants to be in a position to give advice to Mr. $$正太郎$$.」

377:t_10:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't mind that, but don't go slipping stupid jokes into the middle of combat like a certain someone.」

377:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I deny your statement. $$アル$$ was the finest instructor I ever had...」

377:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And you, who refuse to admit that, are the lowest, most wretched dung-bug on earth, a towering heap of excrement... is what $$オックス$$ is saying.」

377:t_10:32.en:
$$カレン$$
「I can't imagine $$正太郎$$'s little brother $$オックス$$ saying anything that vulgar, though.」

377:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-well then, Mr. $$オックス$$! To celebrate your performance today, please pull off a big one!」

377:t_10:35.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then here we go! Let's give it our all again today...」
